unit: Original study patient/sample label; N and T identifiers are not paired by numeric suffix
annotation: Original Ductal cell type 2 interpreted as author malignant-associated; type 1 as relatively nonmalignant ductal, not proof of healthy state. No new CNV validation.
primary_metric: Patient-equal mean of cell log1p(10000 * LYPLA1 UMI / all-gene library UMI)
primary_test: Two-sided permutation of mean difference; paired sign-flip or independent patient-label permutation, 100000 simulations with plus-one correction
primary_bh_family: Both predeclared LYPLA1 primary contrasts; sensitivities are separate and do not select the primary result
sensitivity_metrics: log2 pseudobulk CPM with 0.5 UMI numerator prior
confidence_interval: 20000 patient bootstrap resamples; paired differences resampled together
seed_rule: seed + minimum cell cutoff + contrast index; identical units and measurements reuse the first computed result exactly
sensitivity_p_values: Exploratory unadjusted; not additional independent replications
data_residency: Raw matrices, annotation, barcode links and per-patient measurements remain on server165; only aggregates exported
